text:
Marta: quick thread - ran a tiny run-history sketch for structured outputs. need fast thumbs.

Marta: problems we want to solve: 1) tell which fn produced which field, 2) avoid huge inline arrays, 3) keyboard + SR friendly.

Marta: sketch A - compact badge near fn name: `invoice-parser • v2` + tiny match icon + collapsed JSON that expands on focus or click. microcopy under name: 'Structured output (fields may map to tool calls)'.

Marta: sketch B - pills for each top-level field with type icon; click opens a side sheet with full schema + example. fewer lines, more clicks.

Alex: I lean A for discoverability. how do we avoid heavy visuals in dense timelines?

Samir: make badge lighter in compact density and truncate long schema names; show full on focus. arrays collapse to `array[n]` pill and preview first item.

Jon: accessibility: no hover-only interactions. everything that expands must be focusable and actionable with Enter/Space. add aria-label like 'Structured output from invoice-parser — 3 top-level fields'.

Eve (UX): copy tweak: use 'Structured output (fields may map to tool calls)'. match states should be textual + icon: ✓ Matches / ⚠ Possible mismatch / ✖ No match. avoid color-only cues.

Alex: small debug affordance: red/orange dot when backend match_score < 0.7 with tooltip 'schema mismatch — view example'.

Marta: good. also add 'Copy link to invocation' in 3-dot menu on expanded view for triage.

Samir: implementation note: we already compute match_score in run metadata; can surface it in console-only mode.

Jon: checklist I will author for accessibility testing:
- pills are keyboard-focusable (tab)
- Enter/Space toggles expansion
- aria-expanded reflects state
- aria-describedby points to short summary
- match state includes readable text and icon (not color only)

Marta: will make quick Figma A/B, include Jon's checklist, and open PR with tests. preview link incoming.

PlaygroundBot: preview deployed https://staging.playground.redwood/preview/27345 — includes compact badge and keyboard demo.

Alex: opened preview, looks promising. caveat: badge feels heavy at extreme density, recommend reducing weight for 'compact' mode.

Marta: noted — will add density variants and truncate behavior. PR by EOD tomorrow. :raised_hands:
